user.title: Bambuddy Panel
user.description: Adds Bambuddy to the sidebar. Home Assistant serves it, so it also works over remote access.

data_description.url: Address Home Assistant uses to reach Bambuddy on your network.
data_description.notify_targets: Where bambuddy_panel.notify sends Bambuddy's notifications. In Bambuddy, add a Home Assistant notification provider with service bambuddy_panel.notify.

notify.name: Send Bambuddy notification
notify.description: Sends a notification to the phones chosen in Bambuddy Panel's options. Camera snapshots load through Home Assistant and tapping opens the Bambuddy panel. Used by Bambuddy's Home Assistant notification provider.

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra notify data, e.g. image (a Bambuddy snapshot link is rewritten to load through Home Assistant).
